data.summary: ddflow gate run <phase> unit_tests waited 31 minutes on the suite lock, ran, then printed 'unit_tests ran on e234caf3ce36, but the tree is now at 4fadc519c390: its outcome is superseded and was not recorded' and exited 3. The one commit between them is 'events: complete B-hot-files', which touches only .ddflow/events. services/gates/evidence.py superseded_by scopes by paths (the item's globs), and a phase has no globs, so ancestry alone decides (the B-e47bb1cade scoping does not reach phases). started_on is also taken before the suite-lock wait, so the queue time counts. The verdict and pytest counts are printed nowhere, so the run is lost. On a busy main a phase whole-suite gate may never be recordable. Event-only commits should not supersede, and a superseded run should still say what it found.
data.title: A phase's unit_tests outcome is thrown away by any commit, events-only ones included
